entityDescription:
Emphasis Training Ltd is an expert business-writing training provider and consultancy with over 20 years’ experience. We have helped improve writing and communications skills for over 50,000 delegates and worked with over 5,000 companies in over 32 countries.

Most of the training we deliver are customised in-house group courses, which are tailored to incorporate desired document types, learning objectives and real-life examples. This customisation really brings the content to life and delivers the greatest impact. We also uniquely analyse the writing of each delegate in advance and present the feedback sensitively during the group training. It allows delegates to see how the techniques directly relate to them and provides them with specific takeaways to immediately improve their business writing. 

Our course customisation is partnered with expert, practical delivery. Our trainers all come from long, successful backgrounds in professional communications and we match the trainer's expertise to your organisation. With the absence of PowerPoint, trainers adopt an engaging delivery style with plenty of trainer-led discussions and practical, graded exercises for delegates to work through. 

We have previously delivered customised group training for The European Space Agency, please refer to the summary below:

- The essentials of good scientific and technical writing: two, two-day programmes for your Garching staff (Munich, October 2011)
- The essentials of good business writing: a two-day programme for your Garching staff (Ismaning, November 2011)
- Template development workshop: a one-day programme for your IT team's technical documentation (Munich, March 2015)
- Technical writing skills: a one-day programme for your engineering team (Munich, April 2015) 

The courses received positive feedback, including the below comments:
- Florian Heissenhuber, Head of IT Strategy: 'very useful, 'good handouts and material'
- Francesca Primas, Astronomer/Head of Department: 'I like[d] a lot the refresher crash course on punctuation on grammar!' 
- Katjuscha Lockhart, HR Officer: 'I will profit from the personal feedback'

entityDescription:
We are a studio focused on the research and design of services and products. We collaborate with organizations to make their ideas tangible and translate them into unique projects.
Graphic Facilitation (or scribing) visually documents concepts and highlights connections and patterns that emerge during a conversation. This happens in real time through the active listening of all the contributions of participants and their organization, and translated into clear, immediate, memorable and shareable representations. 
Communicatin. We use graphic design as a tool to better explain messages and concepts. We create products and solutions to communicate with efficiency and impact, marrying the beauty of the design with the coherence of the illustrations, infographics, logos, brand identities, icons and visualizations to support your communication campaigns. 
Illustration. We reveal what is hidden and simplify complexity. Both with drawings and digital tools, our goal is to create effective illustrations and elaborate metaphors, in order to explain complex concepts and help people remember them. 
Video and Animation. We translate stories, processes and strategies into creative videos that help convey a powerful message. Video scribing, animation, events’ reportage and products merging footage with digital: whatever the end result, we will take care of it from the beginning to the end, organizing every technical and creative detail. 
Publishing. We create unique editorial publications: reports, books and clear documents for the transmission of information and at the same time pleasing to the eye and to the touch. We pay attention to readability, aesthetics and we design the product according to the type of recipients. 
Digital Publishing. We design digital tools that leave space for the creativity, play, interactivity, and emotions, to bring attention to contents through a unique and completely new experience for the user. 
Interaction. A fundamental part of the success of an event, space or communication campaign is how much they can stimulate interest and engagement. We research and experiment in this field every day, combining tangible and virtual objects, contents and users.
Environment. We design private environments and shared public spaces, combining aesthetics, utility and effectiveness in communication. Environments that improve the interaction among users, telling stories on large and small surfaces: from exhibition stands and company offices to museums, co-working spaces and commercial activities. 
Artifacts. We create one-of-a-kind objects, designing brand identity and communication tools by taking care of the whole process: from the design to the production and the final quality control. We help you leave a tangible memory of your message. 
Training. We organize trainings courses to improve techniques and practices of the visualization and to develop listening capacities and comprehension of collaborative dynamics, with the objective of learning to find values and solutions in every field, for the person and organizations.

entityDescription:
Institute of Agriculture and Forestry Maribor is a public institute set up by Founding Decree (ULRS 122/2000) on 15.12.2000. The founder was Slovene Chamber of Agriculture and Forestry (non-government farmer organization). The institute has been a legal successor of Institute of Agriculture Maribor in every legal and organizational form since 1894 when it was first established by Provincial Assembly of Štajerska.

Institute is found for performing public services in agriculture advising, professional activities in agriculture plant production and professional activities in animal husbandry, forestry and other activities according with acquired concession on the area Podravje. Regarding with public authorization Institute also performing quality control in agriculture-food production.
Institute performs the following public service activities: advising, teaching and training of farmers, owners and leaseholders of agriculture land and forests and transition of technological, economical and environment protection knowledge. Institute activities based on public authorization are: laboratory activities (pedological, wine and chemical laboratory), estimation of excessive emission influences on soil.
Institute also performs other economical activities and services such as research activities, expert bases for local communities space plans, business plans, projects activities,...).

Company description: The Regional Fund for Science and Technology (FRCT) was created with the objective to coordinate and manage the financial resources available for scientific research and technological development from Regional, European and International programmes.

The FRCT competencies are:

– To promote and participate in the implementation, monitoring, supervision and/or evaluation and the management of studies, programs, projects, training and information and dissemination measures of scientific scope, improvement or technological innovation, as well as the information and knowledge society;

– Foster and promote the support for the scientific development units and/or the regional innovation and technological upgrading and the information and knowledge society and/or in the cooperation with national and foreign counterparts;

– To conclude agreements, protocols and contracts with persons, whether natural or legal, of a public or private nature of Portuguese or foreign nationality, to carry out tasks or services that fit the nature and objectives of the FRCT;

– Promote and hold seminars, conferences, colloquiums and other similar activities in the field of science and technology and the information and knowledge society;

– To promote and carry out the editing of works, journals, monographs, studies and other scientific and technological works;

– Provide subsidies specifically provided for in the activities plan or which, to meet urgent needs, are appropriate, in line with the FRCT’s objectives.

entityDescription: Gabriel Scientific OÜ is an owner of globally patented PneumaPure™ Filter Technology and SleepAngel trademark in order to design, manufacture and sell PneumaPure™ filter enabeled bedding products. (Really) flexible and affordable workspace – whether that’s an office, workshop or laboratory
Access to funding that fills the gap between what an entrepreneur can raise themselves through family and friends and what a Venture Capital firm might fund
Support from highly qualified mentors, coaches and other entrepreneurs through part-funded business support programmes

Though much has changed in the past 30 years, our mission hasn’t, and along the way we have built up a wealth of experience and stories of success – for us and the SMEs we support.

entityDescription: CenSec is the prime Danish cluster for small and medium-sized enterprises specializing in high tech industries like defence, homeland security, space, aerospace, railway and maritime. In 2018, CenSec was approved by the Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science to also become a national Innovation Network for Security (Inno-Sec). Censec has approximately 130 members consisting of companies with cutting edge skills in advanced manufacturing, electronic and software development.
